name: Ra-Thor
summary: Rust research workspace pairing a mercy-gated lattice with optional AI model sessions and a security fixture corpus.
description: Inspectable research software (workspace 14.15.6) from Autonomicity Games Inc.: a Rust monorepo whose default crates are TIERMAP and mercy-security, organized around TOLC 8 'Living Mercy Gates', PATSAGi Councils and a lattice conductor. Adds a Micro-Moment Temporal Comprehension Engine for short-video analysis, a self-evolution cascade and a public white-hat fixture corpus with a mercy-admit CLI for the ingestion gate, plus agent run briefs, Grok presets and small web device pages (/chat.html, /employ.html).

mercy-admit CLI and public white-hat fixture corpus for the ingestion gate
